data.standardized_narrative: Unable to extract gross claims outstanding or a gross prior-year movement from the provided scanned pages with sufficient confidence. The report images provided are rotated and low-resolution in places; gross written premium is visible in the managing agent's summary but detailed technical reserves movement (gross Insurance liabilities movement) is not reliably legible. A manual extract from the original PDF is required to provide authoritative reserve numbers and per-LOB movements.
data.data_quality_notes: Document pages were provided as rotated scanned images with limited legibility. I could not confidently locate the 'Claims outstanding' gross figure in the Statement of Financial Position nor a gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' table. The only clearly legible figure was the total gross written premiums (appears as GBP 116,351 thousand, interpreted as GBP 116.351m) in the managing agent's summary. All reserve-specific fields are left null to avoid reporting potentially incorrect figures. Recommend providing a higher-resolution, correctly oriented PDF (or the specific pages: Statement of Financial Position, Technical provisions note detailing 'claims outstanding' with prior-year comparatives, and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note) for precise extraction.
